thread:
support-alex: FYI - customer jane@acme reporting sharp p99 latency spike on /v1/generate in us-west-2. p95 steady ~220ms but p99 jumped to ~1.8s starting ~5m ago. Correlation id: cid=3f8a2b. Request example: GET /v1/generate?id=abc123

customer-jane: seeing huge lag from the app, degrading UX. started after your last deploy? :worried:

marta-sre: thx Alex. Confirming SLO: p99 <= 500ms for hosted tier, right?

kevin-platform: yes p99 target 500ms. We have an infra rollout 5m ago (deploy-bot posted).

deploy-bot: Deployed inference-runtime@v5.12 (commit abc123) to us-west-2 at 2843009858.

marta-sre: good catch. Initial plan: (1) enable hotpath circuit breaker to short-circuit long-running requests (2) route a percentage of traffic to fallback model (smaller quantized variant) (3) tighten per-token rate limit for new sessions.

raj-oncall: starting runbook steps now. Can someone grab the live p95/p99 graph and top N trace ids?

support-alex: attaching quick snippet from logs around cid=3f8a2b: 
```
2026-03-17T14:51:02Z request cid=3f8a2b model=gpt-open-13b-q4 latency=1800ms status=200
2026-03-17T14:51:03Z request cid=4f9c3d model=gpt-open-13b-q4 latency=1900ms status=200
2026-03-17T14:52:10Z request cid=7a2d11 model=gpt-open-13b-q4 latency=2100ms status=504
```

marta-sre: that 504 + long tail looks like tokenization/kernel path regression. Quick mitigations (flip now):
- enable circuit breaker: `POST /ops/circuit_breakers/hotpath?action=enable`
- set CB thresholds to 2s: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/flags -d '{"hotpath_cb_ms":2000}'`
- fallback routing: set model fallback to `gpt-open-7b-q4f` for 30% traffic in us-west-2
- lower incremental rate limits: per-user -> 5 requests/second for 10m window

kevin-platform: running the flags now. command: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://control-plane/api/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"hotpath_cb_enabled":true, "hotpath_cb_ms":2000, "hotpath_fallback_model":"gpt-open-7b-q4f", "hotpath_fallback_pct":30, "per_user_rps_override":5}'
```

incident-bot: Flag update accepted by control-plane. hotpath_cb_enabled=true hotpath_fallback_pct=30 (applied to us-west-2)

raj-oncall: applied rate limit change at the edge (nginx limit_req zone). Also opened a short-term circuit breaker at runtime: `runtimectl cb set hotpath 2000ms`

marta-sre: checking metrics after 90s..

support-alex: customer reports improvement; app shows faster responses for most requests.

marta-sre: p99 now ~460ms, p95 ~210ms in us-west-2 (last 2m) — looks stable. Will keep CB and fallback on for 15min and then re-evaluate.

kevin-platform: found one suspicious kernel selection change in v5.12 that touched attention kernel heuristics. Marking for rollback if we see recurrence.

deploy-bot: Rolling runtime patch to revert kernel heuristic (canary to 2 nodes in us-west-2).

marta-sre: action items: (A) keep fallback + CB for 15m, (B) collect traces for all requests >800ms, (C) start a canary rollback of kernel heuristic, (D) draft incident ticket for postmortem. Assign owners: Kevin -> rollback, Raj -> tracing, Alex -> customer comms.

support-alex: told customer the mitigations and that we're monitoring. asked them to save any failing request ids. :thumbsup:

kevin-platform: rollback canary initiated. If canary nodes pass 10m without increased p99, we'll roll to remainder.

marta-sre: noted. leaving this thread open for 30m. If any spike >1s reappears, escalate to SRE channel and consider region failover to us-east-1 and bump fallback pct to 60%.

customer-jane: thanks team, latency improved on our end. appreciate the fast response.

marta-sre: closing notes: resolved -> p99 returned under SLO after CB+fallback+rollback canary. Follow-up postmortem ticket: PM-4321.
